item.title: Binance Promotes bStocks Wallet Integration for Tokenized U.S. Equity Exposure
item.summary: Binance highlighted that its bStocks tokenized-securities product — 1:1-backed BEP-20 certificates representing U.S. equities issued under ADGM's regulatory framework — is accessible directly in users' blockchain wallets, allowing unified management of crypto and tokenized stock exposure.
